gdp_yoy.source: MOSPI Provisional Estimates of Annual GDP FY2025-26 (PIB PRID=2269286), released June 5, 2026. Q4 FY26 (Jan–Mar) real GDP growth 7.8%; full-year FY26 at 7.7% (up from 7.1% in FY25). Q3 FY26 was also 7.8% under the new 2022-23 base year series — Q3-to-Q4 growth is flat, not rising.

cpi.source: MOSPI Consumer Price Index Press Release for May 2026 (PIB PRID=2272112), released June 12, 2026. All India CPI YoY 3.93% (provisional); fifth consecutive monthly rise (Jan: 2.75%, Feb: 3.21%, Mar: 3.40%, Apr: 3.48%, May: 3.93%). Rural CPI at 4.25% has breached RBI's 4% medium-term target.

gsec10y.source: CCIL benchmark 10Y G-Sec yield (via Whalesbook and Trading Economics aggregating CCIL data): 6.85% on June 19, 2026. RBI Bulletin May 2026 cited 7.11% on May 21 and 7.02% on April 30 — yield has declined ~0.25pp over the past month. Previous reading on June 6 was 7.12%.

rate_cut_cycle.note: RBI MPC held repo rate at 5.25% on June 5, 2026 (third consecutive hold; unanimous decision); neutral policy stance maintained. Cumulative 125 bps eased Feb–Dec 2025 remains paused. Rising CPI (3.93% in May, breaching 4% in rural) and elevated energy prices limit near-term cuts. Next MPC meeting: August 2026.
rate_cut_cycle.source: RBI MPC Resolution June 5, 2026 — repo rate held at 5.25%, neutral stance (via Upstox market news; Business Standard RBI June MPC coverage).

gov_capex.note: FY27 Union Budget targets ₹12.2 lakh crore capex (4.4% of GDP, highest ever, +11.5% vs FY26 RE), focused on highways, railways and metros; PIB 'Infrastructure Financing in India' policy paper (March 18, 2026) reaffirms institutional framework; CGA April FY27 data (released May 2026) shows sharp YoY expansion in capital spending in the first month of FY27. Note: FY26 year-end saw ₹33,055 crore capex trimmed to meet fiscal deficit target — FY27 starts fresh with record allocation.
gov_capex.source: PIB Infrastructure Financing in India: Trends, Institutions and Innovations (PRID=2241612, March 18, 2026); Business Standard — CGA April FY27 analysis (June 2026); Union Budget 2026-27 capex allocation (PIB, Feb 1, 2026).

china_plus_one.note: Cabinet (March 10, 2026) amended Press Note 3 to allow up to 10% non-controlling Chinese FDI via automatic route in electronics and capital goods, deepening supply-chain integration; Manufacturing FDI +18% YoY in FY25 to USD 19.04 bn; Apple iPhone exports from India crossed ₹2 tn in 2025 (+85% YoY); PLI electronic components scheme (₹22,919 cr) active; BusinessToday analysis (June 2, 2026) confirms manufacturing diversification to India is ongoing.
china_plus_one.source: PIB Cabinet Press Release PRID=2237806 — Press Note 3 amendment (March 2026); BusinessToday — 'Can China+1 help India create millions of jobs?' (June 2, 2026); DPIIT FDI Statistics FY25.

rural_recovery.note: IMD Updated Long Range Forecast (May 29, 2026) downgraded SW Monsoon 2026 to 90% of LPA with 60% probability of deficient season (prior April forecast: 92% LPA); kharif sowing (June 12, 2026) at 84.6 lakh ha vs 88 lakh ha last year (−4% YoY); cotton area down 28% YoY; pulses area down significantly; CCEA approved higher MSPs for 14 kharif crops (May 14, 2026) providing partial income cushion. Farm cash flows and food prices under pressure.
rural_recovery.source: IMD Updated Long Range Forecast for SW Monsoon 2026 (PIB PRID=2266479, May 29, 2026); Agriculture Ministry kharif sowing report (June 12, 2026, via BizzBuzz/Downtoearth); CCEA MSP decision for kharif 2026-27 (DD News, May 14, 2026).

put_call_ratio.source: NSE Nifty 50 option chain aggregate (total put OI / total call OI) via NiftyInvest (NSE data aggregator), as of June 19, 2026 (last trading session before June 20 Saturday). PCR = 1.1139.
